   122→  private head: ProtoBlock;
   123→  /**
   124→   * Only cache attestation data root hex if it's tree backed since it's available.
   125→   **/
   126→  private validatedAttestationDatas = new Set<string>();
   127→  /** Boost the entire branch with this proposer root as the leaf */
   128→  private proposerBoostRoot: RootHex | null = null;
   129→  /** Score to use in proposer boost, evaluated lazily from justified balances */
   130→  private justifiedProposerBoostScore: number | null = null;
   131→  /** The current effective balances */
   132→  private balances: EffectiveBalanceIncrements;
   133→  /**
   134→   * Instantiates a Fork Choice from some existing components
   135→   *
   136→   * This is useful if the existing components have been loaded from disk after a process restart.
   137→   */
   138→  constructor(
   139→    private readonly config: ChainForkConfig,
   140→    private readonly fcStore: IForkChoiceStore,
   141→    /** The underlying representation of the block DAG. */
   142→    private readonly protoArray: ProtoArray,
   143→    readonly metrics: ForkChoiceMetrics | null,
   144→    private readonly opts?: ForkChoiceOpts,
   145→    private readonly logger?: Logger
   146→  ) {
   147→    this.head = this.updateHead();
   148→    this.balances = this.fcStore.justified.balances;
   149→
   150→    metrics?.forkChoice.votes.addCollect(() => {
   151→      metrics.forkChoice.votes.set(this.votes.length);
   152→      metrics.forkChoice.queuedAttestations.set(this.queuedAttestationsPreviousSlot);
   153→      metrics.forkChoice.validatedAttestationDatas.set(this.validatedAttestationDatas.size);
   154→      metrics.forkChoice.balancesLength.set(this.balances.length);
   155→      metrics.forkChoice.nodes.set(this.protoArray.nodes.length);
   156→      metrics.forkChoice.indices.set(this.protoArray.indices.size);
   157→    });
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  /**
   161→   * Returns the block root of an ancestor of `blockRoot` at the given `slot`.
   162→   * (Note: `slot` refers to the block that is *returned*, not the one that is supplied.)
   163→   *
   164→   * NOTE: May be expensive: potentially walks through the entire fork of head to finalized block
   165→   *
   166→   * ### Specification
   167→   *
   168→   * Equivalent to:
   169→   *
   170→   * https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.1.10/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#get_ancestor
   171→   */
   172→  getAncestor(blockRoot: RootHex, ancestorSlot: Slot): RootHex {
   173→    return this.protoArray.getAncestor(blockRoot, ancestorSlot);
   174→  }
   175→
   176→  /**
   177→   * Get the cached head root
   178→   */
   179→  getHeadRoot(): RootHex {
   180→    return this.getHead().blockRoot;
   181→  }
   182→
   183→  /**
   184→   * Get the cached head
   185→   */
   186→  getHead(): ProtoBlock {
   187→    return this.head;
   188→  }
   189→
   190→  /**
   191→   *
   192→   * A multiplexer to wrap around the traditional `updateHead()` according to the scenario
   193→   * Scenarios as follow:
   194→   *    Prepare to propose in the next slot: getHead() -> predictProposerHead()
   195→   *    Proposing in the current slot: updateHead() -> getProposerHead()
   196→   *    Others eg. initializing forkchoice, importBlock: updateHead()
   197→   *
   198→   * Only `GetProposerHead` returns additional field `isHeadTimely` and `notReorgedReason` for metrics purpose
   199→   */
   200→  updateAndGetHead(opt: UpdateAndGetHeadOpt): {
   201→    head: ProtoBlock;
   202→    isHeadTimely?: boolean;
   203→    notReorgedReason?: NotReorgedReason;
   204→  } {
   205→    const {mode} = opt;
   206→
   207→    const canonicalHeadBlock = mode === UpdateHeadOpt.GetPredictedProposerHead ? this.getHead() : this.updateHead();
   208→    switch (mode) {
   209→      case UpdateHeadOpt.GetPredictedProposerHead:
   210→        return {head: this.predictProposerHead(canonicalHeadBlock, opt.secFromSlot, opt.slot)};
   211→      case UpdateHeadOpt.GetProposerHead: {
   212→        const {
   213→          proposerHead: head,
   214→          isHeadTimely,
   215→          notReorgedReason,
   216→        } = this.getProposerHead(canonicalHeadBlock, opt.secFromSlot, opt.slot);
   217→        return {head, isHeadTimely, notReorgedReason};
   218→      }
   219→      case UpdateHeadOpt.GetCanonicalHead:
   220→        return {head: canonicalHeadBlock};
   221→      default:
   222→        return {head: canonicalHeadBlock};
   223→    }
   224→  }
   225→
   226→  // Called by `predictProposerHead` and `importBlock`. If the result is not same as blockRoot's block, return true else false
   227→  // See https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.5.0/specs/bellatrix/fork-choice.md#should_override_forkchoice_update
   228→  // Return true if the given block passes all criteria to be re-orged out
   229→  // Return false otherwise.
   230→  // Note when proposer boost reorg is disabled, it always returns false
   231→  shouldOverrideForkChoiceUpdate(
   232→    blockRoot: RootHex,
   233→    secFromSlot: number,
   234→    currentSlot: Slot
   235→  ): ShouldOverrideForkChoiceUpdateResult {
   236→    const headBlock = this.getBlockHex(blockRoot);
   237→    if (headBlock === null) {
   238→      // should not happen because this block just got imported. Fall back to no-reorg.
   239→      return {shouldOverrideFcu: false, reason: NotReorgedReason.HeadBlockNotAvailable};
   240→    }
   241→    const {proposerBoost, proposerBoostReorg} = this.opts ?? {};
   242→    // Skip re-org attempt if proposer boost (reorg) are disabled
   243→    if (!proposerBoost || !proposerBoostReorg) {
   244→      this.logger?.verbose("Skip shouldOverrideForkChoiceUpdate check since the related flags are disabled", {
   245→        slot: currentSlot,
   246→        proposerBoost,
   247→        proposerBoostReorg,
   248→      });
   249→      return {shouldOverrideFcu: false, reason: NotReorgedReason.ProposerBoostReorgDisabled};
   250→    }
   251→
   252→    const parentBlock = this.protoArray.getBlock(headBlock.parentRoot);
   253→    const proposalSlot = headBlock.slot + 1;
   254→
   255→    // No reorg if parentBlock isn't available
   256→    if (parentBlock === undefined) {
   257→      return {shouldOverrideFcu: false, reason: NotReorgedReason.ParentBlockNotAvailable};
   258→    }
   259→
   260→    const {prelimProposerHead, prelimNotReorgedReason} = this.getPreliminaryProposerHead(
   261→      headBlock,
   262→      parentBlock,
   263→      proposalSlot
   264→    );
   265→
   266→    if (prelimProposerHead === headBlock) {
   267→      return {shouldOverrideFcu: false, reason: prelimNotReorgedReason ?? NotReorgedReason.Unknown};
   268→    }
   269→
   270→    const currentTimeOk =
   271→      headBlock.slot === currentSlot || (proposalSlot === currentSlot && this.isProposingOnTime(secFromSlot));
   272→    if (!currentTimeOk) {
   273→      return {shouldOverrideFcu: false, reason: NotReorgedReason.ReorgMoreThanOneSlot};
   274→    }
   275→
   276→    this.logger?.verbose("Block is weak. Should override forkchoice update", {blockRoot, slot: currentSlot});
   277→    return {shouldOverrideFcu: true, parentBlock};
   278→  }
   279→
   280→  /**
   281→   * Get the proposer boost root
   282→   */
   283→  getProposerBoostRoot(): RootHex {
   284→    return this.proposerBoostRoot ?? HEX_ZERO_HASH;
   285→  }
   286→
   287→  /**
   288→   * To predict the proposer head of the next slot. That is, to predict if proposer-boost-reorg could happen.
   289→   * Reason why we can't be certain is because information of the head block is not fully available yet
   290→   * since the current slot hasn't ended especially the attesters' votes.
   291→   *
   292→   * There is a chance we mispredict.
   293→   *
   294→   * By calling this function, we assume we are the proposer of next slot
   295→   *
   296→   */
   297→  predictProposerHead(headBlock: ProtoBlock, secFromSlot: number, currentSlot: Slot): ProtoBlock {
   298→    const {proposerBoost, proposerBoostReorg} = this.opts ?? {};
   299→    // Skip re-org attempt if proposer boost (reorg) are disabled
   300→    if (!proposerBoost || !proposerBoostReorg) {
   301→      this.logger?.verbose("No proposer boost reorg prediction since the related flags are disabled", {
   302→        slot: currentSlot,
   303→        proposerBoost,
   304→        proposerBoostReorg,
   305→      });
   306→      return headBlock;
   307→    }
   308→
   309→    const blockRoot = headBlock.blockRoot;
   310→    const result = this.shouldOverrideForkChoiceUpdate(blockRoot, secFromSlot, currentSlot);
   311→
   312→    if (result.shouldOverrideFcu) {
   313→      this.logger?.verbose("Current head is weak. Predicting next block to be built on parent of head.", {
   314→        slot: currentSlot,
   315→        proposerHead: result.parentBlock.blockRoot,
   316→        weakHead: blockRoot,
   317→      });
   318→      return result.parentBlock;
   319→    }
   320→
   321→    this.logger?.verbose("Current head is strong. Predicting next block to be built on head", {
   322→      slot: currentSlot,
   323→      head: headBlock.blockRoot,
   324→      reason: result.reason,
   325→    });
   326→
   327→    return headBlock;
   328→  }
   329→
   330→  /**
   331→   *
   332→   * This function takes in the canonical head block and determine the proposer head (canonical head block or its parent)
   333→   * https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3034 for info about proposer boost reorg
   334→   * This function should only be called during block proposal and only be called after `updateHead()` in `updateAndGetHead()`
   335→   *
   336→   * Same as https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0-beta.4/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#get_proposer_head
   337→   */
   338→  getProposerHead(
   339→    headBlock: ProtoBlock,
   340→    secFromSlot: number,
   341→    slot: Slot
   342→  ): {proposerHead: ProtoBlock; isHeadTimely: boolean; notReorgedReason?: NotReorgedReason} {
   343→    const isHeadTimely = headBlock.timeliness;
   344→    let proposerHead = headBlock;
   345→
   346→    // Skip re-org attempt if proposer boost (reorg) are disabled
   347→    const {proposerBoost, proposerBoostReorg} = this.opts ?? {};
   348→    if (!proposerBoost || !proposerBoostReorg) {
   349→      this.logger?.verbose("No proposer boost reorg attempt since the related flags are disabled", {
   350→        slot,
   351→        proposerBoost,
   352→        proposerBoostReorg,
   353→      });
   354→      return {proposerHead, isHeadTimely, notReorgedReason: NotReorgedReason.ProposerBoostReorgDisabled};
   355→    }
   356→
   357→    const parentBlock = this.protoArray.getBlock(headBlock.parentRoot);
   358→
   359→    // No reorg if parentBlock isn't available
   360→    if (parentBlock === undefined) {
   361→      return {proposerHead, isHeadTimely, notReorgedReason: NotReorgedReason.ParentBlockNotAvailable};
   362→    }
   363→
   364→    const {prelimProposerHead, prelimNotReorgedReason} = this.getPreliminaryProposerHead(headBlock, parentBlock, slot);
   365→
   366→    if (prelimProposerHead === headBlock && prelimNotReorgedReason !== undefined) {
   367→      return {proposerHead, isHeadTimely, notReorgedReason: prelimNotReorgedReason};
   368→    }
   369→
   370→    // Only re-org if we are proposing on-time
   371→    if (!this.isProposingOnTime(secFromSlot)) {
   372→      return {proposerHead, isHeadTimely, notReorgedReason: NotReorgedReason.NotProposingOnTime};
   373→    }
   374→
   375→    // No reorg if attempted reorg is more than a single slot
   376→    // Half of single_slot_reorg check in the spec is done in getPreliminaryProposerHead()
   377→    const currentTimeOk = headBlock.slot + 1 === slot;
   378→    if (!currentTimeOk) {
   379→      return {proposerHead, isHeadTimely, notReorgedReason: NotReorgedReason.ReorgMoreThanOneSlot};
   380→    }
   381→
   382→    // No reorg if proposer boost is still in effect
   383→    const isProposerBoostWornOff = this.proposerBoostRoot !== headBlock.blockRoot;
   384→    if (!isProposerBoostWornOff) {
   385→      return {proposerHead, isHeadTimely, notReorgedReason: NotReorgedReason.ProposerBoostNotWornOff};
   386→    }
   387→
   388→    // No reorg if headBlock is "not weak" ie. headBlock's weight exceeds (REORG_HEAD_WEIGHT_THRESHOLD = 20)% of total attester weight
   389→    // https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0-beta.4/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#is_head_weak
   390→    const reorgThreshold = getCommitteeFraction(this.fcStore.justified.totalBalance, {
   391→      slotsPerEpoch: SLOTS_PER_EPOCH,
   392→      committeePercent: this.config.REORG_HEAD_WEIGHT_THRESHOLD,
   393→    });
   394→    const headNode = this.protoArray.getNode(headBlock.blockRoot);
   395→    // If headNode is unavailable, give up reorg
   396→    if (headNode === undefined || headNode.weight >= reorgThreshold) {
   397→      return {proposerHead, isHeadTimely, notReorgedReason: NotReorgedReason.HeadBlockNotWeak};
   398→    }
   399→
   400→    // No reorg if parentBlock is "not strong" ie. parentBlock's weight is less than or equal to (REORG_PARENT_WEIGHT_THRESHOLD = 160)% of total attester weight
   401→    // https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#is_parent_strong
   402→    const parentThreshold = getCommitteeFraction(this.fcStore.justified.totalBalance, {
   403→      slotsPerEpoch: SLOTS_PER_EPOCH,
   404→      committeePercent: this.config.REORG_PARENT_WEIGHT_THRESHOLD,
   405→    });
   406→    const parentNode = this.protoArray.getNode(parentBlock.blockRoot);
   407→    // If parentNode is unavailable, give up reorg
   408→    if (parentNode === undefined || parentNode.weight <= parentThreshold) {
   409→      return {proposerHead, isHeadTimely, notReorgedReason: NotReorgedReason.ParentBlockNotStrong};
   410→    }
   411→
   412→    // Reorg if all above checks fail
   413→    this.logger?.verbose("Performing single-slot reorg to remove current weak head", {
   414→      slot,
   415→      proposerHead: parentBlock.blockRoot,
   416→      weakHead: headBlock.blockRoot,
   417→    });
   418→    proposerHead = parentBlock;
   419→
   420→    return {proposerHead, isHeadTimely};
   421→  }
   422→
   423→  /**
   424→   * Run the fork choice rule to determine the head.
   425→   * Update the head cache.
   426→   *
   427→   * Very expensive function (400ms / run as of Aug 2021). Call when the head really needs to be re-calculated.
   428→   *
   429→   * ## Specification
   430→   *
   431→   * Is equivalent to:
   432→   *
   433→   * https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.1.10/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#get_head
   434→   */
   435→  updateHead(): ProtoBlock {
   436→    // balances is not changed but votes are changed
   437→
   438→    // NOTE: In current Lodestar metrics, 100% of forkChoiceRequests this.synced = false.
   439→    // No need to cache computeDeltas()
   440→    //
   441→    // TODO: In current Lodestar metrics, 100% of forkChoiceRequests result in a changed head.
   442→    // No need to cache the head anymore
   443→
   444→    // Check if scores need to be calculated/updated
   445→    const oldBalances = this.balances;
   446→    const newBalances = this.fcStore.justified.balances;
   447→    const deltas = computeDeltas(
   448→      this.protoArray.nodes.length,
   449→      this.votes,
   450→      oldBalances,
   451→      newBalances,
   452→      this.fcStore.equivocatingIndices
   453→    );
   454→    this.balances = newBalances;
   455→    /**
   456→     * The structure in line with deltas to propagate boost up the branch
   457→     * starting from the proposerIndex
   458→     */
   459→    let proposerBoost: {root: RootHex; score: number} | null = null;
   460→    if (this.opts?.proposerBoost && this.proposerBoostRoot) {
   461→      const proposerBoostScore =
   462→        this.justifiedProposerBoostScore ??
   463→        getCommitteeFraction(this.fcStore.justified.totalBalance, {
   464→          slotsPerEpoch: SLOTS_PER_EPOCH,
   465→          committeePercent: this.config.PROPOSER_SCORE_BOOST,
   466→        });
   467→      proposerBoost = {root: this.proposerBoostRoot, score: proposerBoostScore};
   468→      this.justifiedProposerBoostScore = proposerBoostScore;
   469→    }
   470→
   471→    const currentSlot = this.fcStore.currentSlot;
   472→    this.protoArray.applyScoreChanges({
   473→      deltas,
   474→      proposerBoost,
   475→      justifiedEpoch: this.fcStore.justified.checkpoint.epoch,
   476→      justifiedRoot: this.fcStore.justified.checkpoint.rootHex,
   477→      finalizedEpoch: this.fcStore.finalizedCheckpoint.epoch,
   478→      finalizedRoot: this.fcStore.finalizedCheckpoint.rootHex,
   479→      currentSlot,
   480→    });
   481→
   482→    const headRoot = this.protoArray.findHead(this.fcStore.justified.checkpoint.rootHex, currentSlot);
   483→    const headIndex = this.protoArray.indices.get(headRoot);
   484→    if (headIndex === undefined) {
   485→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
   486→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.MISSING_PROTO_ARRAY_BLOCK,
   487→        root: headRoot,
   488→      });
   489→    }
   490→    const headNode = this.protoArray.nodes[headIndex];
   491→    if (headNode === undefined) {
   492→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
   493→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.MISSING_PROTO_ARRAY_BLOCK,
   494→        root: headRoot,
   495→      });
   496→    }
   497→
   498→    this.head = headNode;
   499→    return this.head;
   500→  }
   501→
   502→  /**
   503→   * An iteration over protoArray to get present slots, to be called preemptively
   504→   * from prepareNextSlot to prevent delay on produceBlindedBlock
   505→   * @param windowStart is the slot after which (excluding) to provide present slots
   506→   */
   507→  getSlotsPresent(windowStart: number): number {
   508→    return this.protoArray.nodes.filter((node) => node.slot > windowStart).length;
   509→  }
   510→
   511→  /** Very expensive function, iterates the entire ProtoArray. Called only in debug API */
   512→  getHeads(): ProtoBlock[] {
   513→    return this.protoArray.nodes.filter((node) => node.bestChild === undefined);
   514→  }
   515→
   516→  /** This is for the debug API only */
   517→  getAllNodes(): ProtoNode[] {
   518→    return this.protoArray.nodes;
   519→  }
   520→
   521→  getFinalizedCheckpoint(): CheckpointWithHex {
   522→    return this.fcStore.finalizedCheckpoint;
   523→  }
   524→
   525→  getJustifiedCheckpoint(): CheckpointWithHex {
   526→    return this.fcStore.justified.checkpoint;
   527→  }
   528→
   529→  /**
   530→   * Add `block` to the fork choice DAG.
   531→   *
   532→   * ## Specification
   533→   *
   534→   * Approximates:
   535→   *
   536→   * https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.1.10/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#on_block
   537→   *
   538→   * It only approximates the specification since it does not run the `state_transition` check.
   539→   * That should have already been called upstream and it's too expensive to call again.
   540→   *
   541→   * ## Notes:
   542→   *
   543→   * The supplied block **must** pass the `state_transition` function as it will not be run here.
   544→   *
   545→   * `justifiedBalances` balances of justified state which is updated synchronously.
   546→   * This ensures that the forkchoice is never out of sync.
   547→   */
   548→  onBlock(
   549→    block: BeaconBlock,
   550→    state: CachedBeaconStateAllForks,
   551→    blockDelaySec: number,
   552→    currentSlot: Slot,
   553→    executionStatus: MaybeValidExecutionStatus,
   554→    dataAvailabilityStatus: DataAvailabilityStatus
   555→  ): ProtoBlock {
   556→    const {parentRoot, slot} = block;
   557→    const parentRootHex = toRootHex(parentRoot);
   558→    // Parent block must be known
   559→    const parentBlock = this.protoArray.getBlock(parentRootHex);
   560→    if (!parentBlock) {
   561→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
   562→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.INVALID_BLOCK,
   563→        err: {
   564→          code: InvalidBlockCode.UNKNOWN_PARENT,
   565→          root: parentRootHex,
   566→        },
   567→      });
   568→    }
   569→
   570→    // Blocks cannot be in the future. If they are, their consideration must be delayed until
   571→    // the are in the past.
   572→    //
   573→    // Note: presently, we do not delay consideration. We just drop the block.
   574→    if (slot > this.fcStore.currentSlot) {
   575→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
   576→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.INVALID_BLOCK,
   577→        err: {
   578→          code: InvalidBlockCode.FUTURE_SLOT,
   579→          currentSlot: this.fcStore.currentSlot,
   580→          blockSlot: slot,
   581→        },
   582→      });
   583→    }
   584→
   585→    // Check that block is later than the finalized epoch slot (optimization to reduce calls to
   586→    // get_ancestor).
   587→    const finalizedSlot = computeStartSlotAtEpoch(this.fcStore.finalizedCheckpoint.epoch);
   588→    if (slot <= finalizedSlot) {
   589→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
   590→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.INVALID_BLOCK,
   591→        err: {
   592→          code: InvalidBlockCode.FINALIZED_SLOT,
   593→          finalizedSlot,
   594→          blockSlot: slot,
   595→        },
   596→      });
   597→    }
   598→
   599→    // Check block is a descendant of the finalized block at the checkpoint finalized slot.
   600→    const blockAncestorRoot = this.getAncestor(parentRootHex, finalizedSlot);
   601→    const finalizedRoot = this.fcStore.finalizedCheckpoint.rootHex;
   602→    if (blockAncestorRoot !== finalizedRoot) {
   603→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
   604→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.INVALID_BLOCK,
   605→        err: {
   606→          code: InvalidBlockCode.NOT_FINALIZED_DESCENDANT,
   607→          finalizedRoot,
   608→          blockAncestor: blockAncestorRoot,
   609→        },
   610→      });
   611→    }
   612→
   613→    const blockRoot = this.config.getForkTypes(slot).BeaconBlock.hashTreeRoot(block);
   614→    const blockRootHex = toRootHex(blockRoot);
   615→
   616→    // Assign proposer score boost if the block is timely
   617→    // before attesting interval = before 1st interval
   618→    const isTimely = this.isBlockTimely(block, blockDelaySec);
   619→    if (
   620→      this.opts?.proposerBoost &&
   621→      isTimely &&
   622→      // only boost the first block we see
   623→      this.proposerBoostRoot === null
   624→    ) {
   625→      this.proposerBoostRoot = blockRootHex;
   626→    }
   627→
   628→    // As per specs, we should be validating here the terminal conditions of
   629→    // the PoW if this were a merge transition block.
   630→    // (https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/bellatrix/fork-choice.md#on_block)
   631→    //
   632→    // However this check has been moved to the `verifyBlockStateTransition` in
   633→    // `packages/beacon-node/src/chain/blocks/verifyBlock.ts` as:
   634→    //
   635→    //  1. Its prudent to fail fast and not try importing a block in forkChoice.
   636→    //  2. Also the data to run such a validation is readily available there.
   637→
   638→    const justifiedCheckpoint = toCheckpointWithHex(state.currentJustifiedCheckpoint);
   639→    const finalizedCheckpoint = toCheckpointWithHex(state.finalizedCheckpoint);
   640→    const stateJustifiedEpoch = justifiedCheckpoint.epoch;
   641→
   642→    // Justified balances for `justifiedCheckpoint` are new to the fork-choice. Compute them on demand only if
   643→    // the justified checkpoint changes
   644→    this.updateCheckpoints(justifiedCheckpoint, finalizedCheckpoint, () =>
   645→      this.fcStore.justifiedBalancesGetter(justifiedCheckpoint, state)
   646→    );
   647→
   648→    const blockEpoch = computeEpochAtSlot(slot);
   649→
   650→    // same logic to compute_pulled_up_tip in the spec, making it inline because of reusing variables
   651→    // If the parent checkpoints are already at the same epoch as the block being imported,
   652→    // it's impossible for the unrealized checkpoints to differ from the parent's. This
   653→    // holds true because:
   654→    //
   655→    // 1. A child block cannot have lower FFG checkpoints than its parent.
   656→    // 2. A block in epoch `N` cannot contain attestations which would justify an epoch higher than `N`.
   657→    // 3. A block in epoch `N` cannot contain attestations which would finalize an epoch higher than `N - 1`.
   658→    //
   659→    // This is an optimization. It should reduce the amount of times we run
   660→    // `process_justification_and_finalization` by approximately 1/3rd when the chain is
   661→    // performing optimally.
   662→    let unrealizedJustifiedCheckpoint: CheckpointWithHex;
   663→    let unrealizedFinalizedCheckpoint: CheckpointWithHex;
   664→    if (this.opts?.computeUnrealized) {
   665→      if (
   666→        parentBlock.unrealizedJustifiedEpoch === blockEpoch &&
   667→        parentBlock.unrealizedFinalizedEpoch + 1 >= blockEpoch
   668→      ) {
   669→        // reuse from parent, happens at 1/3 last blocks of epoch as monitored in mainnet
   670→        unrealizedJustifiedCheckpoint = {
   671→          epoch: parentBlock.unrealizedJustifiedEpoch,
   672→          root: fromHex(parentBlock.unrealizedJustifiedRoot),
   673→          rootHex: parentBlock.unrealizedJustifiedRoot,
   674→        };
   675→        unrealizedFinalizedCheckpoint = {
   676→          epoch: parentBlock.unrealizedFinalizedEpoch,
   677→          root: fromHex(parentBlock.unrealizedFinalizedRoot),
   678→          rootHex: parentBlock.unrealizedFinalizedRoot,
   679→        };
   680→      } else {
   681→        // compute new, happens 2/3 first blocks of epoch as monitored in mainnet
   682→        const unrealized = computeUnrealizedCheckpoints(state);
   683→        unrealizedJustifiedCheckpoint = toCheckpointWithHex(unrealized.justifiedCheckpoint);
   684→        unrealizedFinalizedCheckpoint = toCheckpointWithHex(unrealized.finalizedCheckpoint);
   685→      }
   686→    } else {
   687→      unrealizedJustifiedCheckpoint = justifiedCheckpoint;
   688→      unrealizedFinalizedCheckpoint = finalizedCheckpoint;
   689→    }
   690→
   691→    // Un-realized checkpoints
   692→    // Update best known unrealized justified & finalized checkpoints
   693→    this.updateUnrealizedCheckpoints(unrealizedJustifiedCheckpoint, unrealizedFinalizedCheckpoint, () =>
   694→      this.fcStore.justifiedBalancesGetter(unrealizedJustifiedCheckpoint, state)
   695→    );
   696→
   697→    // If block is from past epochs, try to update store's justified & finalized checkpoints right away
   698→    if (blockEpoch < computeEpochAtSlot(currentSlot)) {
   699→      this.updateCheckpoints(unrealizedJustifiedCheckpoint, unrealizedFinalizedCheckpoint, () =>
   700→        this.fcStore.justifiedBalancesGetter(unrealizedJustifiedCheckpoint, state)
   701→      );
   702→    }
   703→
   704→    const targetSlot = computeStartSlotAtEpoch(blockEpoch);
   705→    const targetRoot = slot === targetSlot ? blockRoot : state.blockRoots.get(targetSlot % SLOTS_PER_HISTORICAL_ROOT);
   706→
   707→    // This does not apply a vote to the block, it just makes fork choice aware of the block so
   708→    // it can still be identified as the head even if it doesn't have any votes.
   709→    const protoBlock: ProtoBlock = {
   710→      slot: slot,
   711→      blockRoot: blockRootHex,
   712→      parentRoot: parentRootHex,
   713→      targetRoot: toRootHex(targetRoot),
   714→      stateRoot: toRootHex(block.stateRoot),
   715→      timeliness: isTimely,
   716→
   717→      justifiedEpoch: stateJustifiedEpoch,
   718→      justifiedRoot: toRootHex(state.currentJustifiedCheckpoint.root),
   719→      finalizedEpoch: finalizedCheckpoint.epoch,
   720→      finalizedRoot: toRootHex(state.finalizedCheckpoint.root),
   721→      unrealizedJustifiedEpoch: unrealizedJustifiedCheckpoint.epoch,
   722→      unrealizedJustifiedRoot: unrealizedJustifiedCheckpoint.rootHex,
   723→      unrealizedFinalizedEpoch: unrealizedFinalizedCheckpoint.epoch,
   724→      unrealizedFinalizedRoot: unrealizedFinalizedCheckpoint.rootHex,
   725→
   726→      ...(isExecutionBlockBodyType(block.body) && isExecutionStateType(state) && isExecutionEnabled(state, block)
   727→        ? {
   728→            executionPayloadBlockHash: toRootHex(block.body.executionPayload.blockHash),
   729→            executionPayloadNumber: block.body.executionPayload.blockNumber,
   730→            executionStatus: this.getPostMergeExecStatus(executionStatus),
   731→            dataAvailabilityStatus,
   732→          }
   733→        : {
   734→            executionPayloadBlockHash: null,
   735→            executionStatus: this.getPreMergeExecStatus(executionStatus),
   736→            dataAvailabilityStatus: this.getPreMergeDataStatus(dataAvailabilityStatus),
   737→          }),
   738→    };
   739→
   740→    this.protoArray.onBlock(protoBlock, currentSlot);
   741→
   742→    return protoBlock;
   743→  }

   745→  /**
   746→   * Register `attestation` with the fork choice DAG so that it may influence future calls to `getHead`.
   747→   *
   748→   * ## Specification
   749→   *
   750→   * Approximates:
   751→   *
   752→   * https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.1.10/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#on_attestation
   753→   *
   754→   * It only approximates the specification since it does not perform
   755→   * `is_valid_indexed_attestation` since that should already have been called upstream and it's
   756→   * too expensive to call again.
   757→   *
   758→   * ## Notes:
   759→   *
   760→   * The supplied `attestation` **must** pass the `in_valid_indexed_attestation` function as it
   761→   * will not be run here.
   762→   */
   763→  onAttestation(attestation: IndexedAttestation, attDataRoot: string, forceImport?: boolean): void {
   764→    // Ignore any attestations to the zero hash.
   765→    //
   766→    // This is an edge case that results from the spec aliasing the zero hash to the genesis
   767→    // block. Attesters may attest to the zero hash if they have never seen a block.
   768→    //
   769→    // We have two options here:
   770→    //
   771→    //  1. Apply all zero-hash attestations to the genesis block.
   772→    //  2. Ignore all attestations to the zero hash.
   773→    //
   774→    // (1) becomes weird once we hit finality and fork choice drops the genesis block. (2) is
   775→    // fine because votes to the genesis block are not useful; all validators implicitly attest
   776→    // to genesis just by being present in the chain.
   777→    const attestationData = attestation.data;
   778→    const {slot, beaconBlockRoot} = attestationData;
   779→    const blockRootHex = toRootHex(beaconBlockRoot);
   780→    const targetEpoch = attestationData.target.epoch;
   781→    if (ssz.Root.equals(beaconBlockRoot, ZERO_HASH)) {
   782→      return;
   783→    }

   785→    this.validateOnAttestation(attestation, slot, blockRootHex, targetEpoch, attDataRoot, forceImport);
   786→
   787→    if (slot < this.fcStore.currentSlot) {
   788→      for (const validatorIndex of attestation.attestingIndices) {
   789→        if (!this.fcStore.equivocatingIndices.has(validatorIndex)) {
   790→          this.addLatestMessage(validatorIndex, targetEpoch, blockRootHex);
   791→        }
   792→      }
   793→    } else {
   794→      // The spec declares:
   795→      //
   796→      // ```
   797→      // Attestations can only affect the fork choice of subsequent slots.
   798→      // Delay consideration in the fork choice until their slot is in the past.
   799→      // ```
   800→      const byRoot = this.queuedAttestations.getOrDefault(slot);
   801→      const validatorIndices = byRoot.getOrDefault(blockRootHex);
   802→      for (const validatorIndex of attestation.attestingIndices) {
   803→        if (!this.fcStore.equivocatingIndices.has(validatorIndex)) {
   804→          validatorIndices.add(validatorIndex);
   805→        }
   806→      }
   807→    }
   808→  }

   813→   * in state transition so no need to do it again

   815→  onAttesterSlashing(attesterSlashing: AttesterSlashing): void {

   817→    const intersectingIndices = getAttesterSlashableIndices(attesterSlashing);

   834→  /**

   840→   *   - also side effect of this function is `validatedAttestationDatas` reseted

   842→  updateTime(currentSlot: Slot): void {

   948→  prune(finalizedRoot: RootHex): ProtoBlock[] {
   949→    const prunedNodes = this.protoArray.maybePrune(finalizedRoot);
   950→    const prunedCount = prunedNodes.length;
   951→    for (let i = 0; i < this.votes.length; i++) {
   952→      const vote = this.votes[i];
   953→      // validator has never voted
   954→      if (vote === undefined) {
   955→        continue;
   956→      }
   957→
   958→      if (vote.currentIndex !== null) {
   959→        if (vote.currentIndex >= prunedCount) {
   960→          vote.currentIndex -= prunedCount;
   961→        } else {
   962→          // the vote was for a pruned proto node
   963→          vote.currentIndex = null;
   964→        }
   965→      }
   966→
   967→      if (vote.nextIndex !== null) {
   968→        if (vote.nextIndex >= prunedCount) {
   969→          vote.nextIndex -= prunedCount;
   970→        } else {
   971→          // the vote was for a pruned proto node
   972→          vote.nextIndex = null;
   973→        }
   974→      }
   975→    }
   976→    return prunedNodes;
   977→  }

  1094→  /** Returns the distance of common ancestor of nodes to the max of the newNode and the prevNode. */
  1095→  getCommonAncestorDepth(prevBlock: ProtoBlock, newBlock: ProtoBlock): AncestorResult {

  1098→    if (!prevNode || !newNode) {

  1101→

  1104→    if (!commonAncestor) {

  1110→      return {code: AncestorStatus.Descendant};

  1134→  /**
  1135→   * A dependent root is the block root of the last block before the state transition that decided a specific shuffling
  1136→   *
  1137→   * For proposer shuffling with 0 epochs of lookahead = previous immediate epoch transition
  1138→   * For attester shuffling with 1 epochs of lookahead = last epoch's epoch transition
  1139→   *
  1140→   * ```
  1141→   *         epoch: 0       1       2       3       4
  1142→   *                |-------|-------|=======|-------|
  1143→   * dependent root A -------------^
  1144→   * dependent root B -----^
  1145→   * ```
  1146→   * - proposer shuffling for a block in epoch 2: dependent root A (EpochDifference = 0)
  1147→   * - attester shuffling for a block in epoch 2: dependent root B (EpochDifference = 1)
  1148→   */
  1149→  getDependentRoot(block: ProtoBlock, epochDifference: EpochDifference): RootHex {

  1151→    // jumping to a block with a strictly less slot number. So the condition `blockEpoch < atEpoch`
  1152→    // is guaranteed to happen. Given the use of target blocks for faster navigation, it will take
  1153→    // at most `2 * (blockEpoch - atEpoch + 1)` iterations to find the dependent root.
  1154→

  1156→

  1158→    if (beforeSlot <= 0) {

  1160→      if (genesisBlock === undefined || genesisBlock.slot !== 0) {

  1166→    const finalizedSlot = this.getFinalizedBlock().slot;
  1167→    while (block.slot >= finalizedSlot) {
  1168→      // Dependant root must be in epoch less than `beforeSlot`
  1169→      if (block.slot < beforeSlot) {
  1170→        return block.blockRoot;
  1171→      }
  1172→
  1173→      // Skip one last jump if there's no skipped slot at first slot of the epoch
  1174→      if (block.slot === beforeSlot) {
  1175→        return block.parentRoot;
  1176→      }
  1177→
  1178→      block =
  1179→        block.blockRoot === block.targetRoot
  1180→          ? // For the first slot of the epoch, a block is it's own target
  1181→            this.protoArray.getBlockReadonly(block.parentRoot)
  1182→          : // else we can navigate much faster jumping to the target block
  1183→            this.protoArray.getBlockReadonly(block.targetRoot);
  1184→    }
  1185→
  1186→    throw Error(`Not found dependent root for block slot ${block.slot}, epoch difference ${epochDifference}`);
  1187→  }

  1189→  /**
  1190→   * Return true if the block is timely for the current slot.
  1191→   * Child class can overwrite this for testing purpose.
  1192→   */
  1193→  protected isBlockTimely(block: BeaconBlock, blockDelaySec: number): boolean {
  1194→    const isBeforeAttestingInterval = blockDelaySec < this.config.SECONDS_PER_SLOT / INTERVALS_PER_SLOT;
  1195→    return this.fcStore.currentSlot === block.slot && isBeforeAttestingInterval;
  1196→  }

  1198→  /**
  1199→   * https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.5.0/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#is_proposing_on_time
  1200→   */
  1201→  private isProposingOnTime(secFromSlot: number): boolean {
  1202→    const proposerReorgCutoff = this.config.SECONDS_PER_SLOT / INTERVALS_PER_SLOT / 2;
  1203→    return secFromSlot <= proposerReorgCutoff;

  1230→  /**
  1231→   * Why `getJustifiedBalances` getter?
  1232→   * - updateCheckpoints() is called in both on_block and on_tick.
  1233→   * - Our cache strategy to get justified balances is incomplete, it can't regen all possible states.
  1234→   * - If the justified state is not available it will get one that is "closest" to the justified checkpoint.
  1235→   * - As a last resort fallback the state that references the new justified checkpoint is close or equal to the
  1236→   *   desired justified state. However, the state is available only in the on_block handler
  1237→   * - `getJustifiedBalances` makes the dynamics of justified balances cache easier to reason about
  1238→   *
  1239→   * **`on_block`**:
  1240→   * May need the justified balances of:
  1241→   * - justifiedCheckpoint
  1242→   * - unrealizedJustifiedCheckpoint
  1243→   * These balances are not immediately available so the getter calls a cache fn `() => cache.getBalances()`
  1244→   *
  1245→   * **`on_tick`**
  1246→   * May need the justified balances of:
  1247→   * - unrealizedJustified: Already available in `CheckpointHexWithBalance`
  1248→   * Since this balances are already available the getter is just `() => balances`, without cache interaction
  1249→   */
  1250→  private updateCheckpoints(
  1251→    justifiedCheckpoint: CheckpointWithHex,
  1252→    finalizedCheckpoint: CheckpointWithHex,
  1253→    getJustifiedBalances: () => JustifiedBalances
  1254→  ): void {
  1255→    // Update justified checkpoint.
  1256→    if (justifiedCheckpoint.epoch > this.fcStore.justified.checkpoint.epoch) {
  1257→      this.fcStore.justified = {checkpoint: justifiedCheckpoint, balances: getJustifiedBalances()};
  1258→      this.justifiedProposerBoostScore = null;
  1259→    }
  1260→
  1261→    // Update finalized checkpoint.
  1262→    if (finalizedCheckpoint.epoch > this.fcStore.finalizedCheckpoint.epoch) {
  1263→      this.fcStore.finalizedCheckpoint = finalizedCheckpoint;
  1264→      this.justifiedProposerBoostScore = null;
  1265→    }
  1266→  }

  1268→  /**
  1269→   * Update unrealized checkpoints in store if necessary

  1271→  private updateUnrealizedCheckpoints(
  1272→    unrealizedJustifiedCheckpoint: CheckpointWithHex,
  1273→    unrealizedFinalizedCheckpoint: CheckpointWithHex,

  1275→  ): void {
  1276→    if (unrealizedJustifiedCheckpoint.epoch > this.fcStore.unrealizedJustified.checkpoint.epoch) {
  1277→      this.fcStore.unrealizedJustified = {
  1278→        checkpoint: unrealizedJustifiedCheckpoint,
  1279→        balances: getJustifiedBalances(),
  1280→      };
  1281→    }
  1282→    if (unrealizedFinalizedCheckpoint.epoch > this.fcStore.unrealizedFinalizedCheckpoint.epoch) {
  1283→      this.fcStore.unrealizedFinalizedCheckpoint = unrealizedFinalizedCheckpoint;
  1284→    }

  1287→  /**
  1288→   * Validates the `indexed_attestation` for application to fork choice.
  1289→   *
  1290→   * ## Specification
  1291→   *
  1292→   * Equivalent to:
  1293→   *
  1294→   * https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.1.10/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#validate_on_attestation
  1295→   */
  1296→  private validateOnAttestation(
  1297→    indexedAttestation: IndexedAttestation,
  1298→    slot: Slot,
  1299→    blockRootHex: string,
  1300→    targetEpoch: Epoch,
  1301→    attDataRoot: string,
  1302→    // forceImport attestation even if too old, mostly used in spec tests
  1303→    forceImport?: boolean
  1304→  ): void {
  1305→    // There is no point in processing an attestation with an empty bitfield. Reject
  1306→    // it immediately.
  1307→    //
  1308→    // This is not in the specification, however it should be transparent to other nodes. We
  1309→    // return early here to avoid wasting precious resources verifying the rest of it.
  1310→    if (!indexedAttestation.attestingIndices.length) {
  1311→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
  1312→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.INVALID_ATTESTATION,
  1313→        err: {
  1314→          code: InvalidAttestationCode.EMPTY_AGGREGATION_BITFIELD,
  1315→        },
  1316→      });
  1317→    }
  1318→
  1319→    if (!this.validatedAttestationDatas.has(attDataRoot)) {
  1320→      this.validateAttestationData(indexedAttestation.data, slot, blockRootHex, targetEpoch, attDataRoot, forceImport);
  1321→    }
  1322→  }

  1324→  private validateAttestationData(
  1325→    attestationData: phase0.AttestationData,
  1326→    slot: Slot,
  1327→    beaconBlockRootHex: string,
  1328→    targetEpoch: Epoch,
  1329→    attDataRoot: string,
  1330→    // forceImport attestation even if too old, mostly used in spec tests
  1331→    forceImport?: boolean
  1332→  ): void {
  1333→    const epochNow = computeEpochAtSlot(this.fcStore.currentSlot);
  1334→    const targetRootHex = toRootHex(attestationData.target.root);
  1335→
  1336→    // Attestation must be from the current of previous epoch.
  1337→    if (targetEpoch > epochNow) {
  1338→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
  1339→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.INVALID_ATTESTATION,
  1340→        err: {
  1341→          code: InvalidAttestationCode.FUTURE_EPOCH,
  1342→          attestationEpoch: targetEpoch,
  1343→          currentEpoch: epochNow,
  1344→        },
  1345→      });
  1346→    }
  1347→
  1348→    if (!forceImport && targetEpoch + 1 < epochNow) {
  1349→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
  1350→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.INVALID_ATTESTATION,
  1351→        err: {
  1352→          code: InvalidAttestationCode.PAST_EPOCH,
  1353→          attestationEpoch: targetEpoch,
  1354→          currentEpoch: epochNow,
  1355→        },
  1356→      });
  1357→    }
  1358→
  1359→    if (targetEpoch !== computeEpochAtSlot(slot)) {
  1360→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
  1361→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.INVALID_ATTESTATION,
  1362→        err: {
  1363→          code: InvalidAttestationCode.BAD_TARGET_EPOCH,
  1364→          target: targetEpoch,
  1365→          slot,
  1366→        },
  1367→      });
  1368→    }
  1369→
  1370→    // Attestation target must be for a known block.
  1371→    //
  1372→    // We do not delay the block for later processing to reduce complexity and DoS attack
  1373→    // surface.
  1374→    if (!this.protoArray.hasBlock(targetRootHex)) {
  1375→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
  1376→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.INVALID_ATTESTATION,
  1377→        err: {
  1378→          code: InvalidAttestationCode.UNKNOWN_TARGET_ROOT,
  1379→          root: targetRootHex,
  1380→        },
  1381→      });
  1382→    }
  1383→
  1384→    // Load the block for `attestation.data.beacon_block_root`.
  1385→    //
  1386→    // This indirectly checks to see if the `attestation.data.beacon_block_root` is in our fork
  1387→    // choice. Any known, non-finalized block should be in fork choice, so this check
  1388→    // immediately filters out attestations that attest to a block that has not been processed.
  1389→    //
  1390→    // Attestations must be for a known block. If the block is unknown, we simply drop the
  1391→    // attestation and do not delay consideration for later.
  1392→    const block = this.protoArray.getBlock(beaconBlockRootHex);
  1393→    if (!block) {
  1394→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
  1395→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.INVALID_ATTESTATION,
  1396→        err: {
  1397→          code: InvalidAttestationCode.UNKNOWN_HEAD_BLOCK,
  1398→          beaconBlockRoot: beaconBlockRootHex,
  1399→        },
  1400→      });
  1401→    }
  1402→
  1403→    // If an attestation points to a block that is from an earlier slot than the attestation,
  1404→    // then all slots between the block and attestation must be skipped. Therefore if the block
  1405→    // is from a prior epoch to the attestation, then the target root must be equal to the root
  1406→    // of the block that is being attested to.
  1407→    const expectedTargetHex = targetEpoch > computeEpochAtSlot(block.slot) ? beaconBlockRootHex : block.targetRoot;
  1408→
  1409→    if (expectedTargetHex !== targetRootHex) {
  1410→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
  1411→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.INVALID_ATTESTATION,
  1412→        err: {
  1413→          code: InvalidAttestationCode.INVALID_TARGET,
  1414→          attestation: targetRootHex,
  1415→          local: expectedTargetHex,
  1416→        },
  1417→      });
  1418→    }
  1419→
  1420→    // Attestations must not be for blocks in the future. If this is the case, the attestation
  1421→    // should not be considered.
  1422→    if (block.slot > slot) {
  1423→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
  1424→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.INVALID_ATTESTATION,
  1425→        err: {
  1426→          code: InvalidAttestationCode.ATTESTS_TO_FUTURE_BLOCK,
  1427→          block: block.slot,
  1428→          attestation: slot,
  1429→        },
  1430→      });
  1431→    }
  1432→
  1433→    this.validatedAttestationDatas.add(attDataRoot);
  1434→  }

  1436→  /**
  1437→   * Add a validator's latest message to the tracked votes
  1438→   */
  1439→  private addLatestMessage(validatorIndex: ValidatorIndex, nextEpoch: Epoch, nextRoot: RootHex): void {
  1440→    const vote = this.votes[validatorIndex];
  1441→    // should not happen, attestation is validated before this step
  1442→    const nextIndex = this.protoArray.indices.get(nextRoot);
  1443→    if (nextIndex === undefined) {
  1444→      throw new Error(`Could not find proto index for nextRoot ${nextRoot}`);
  1445→    }
  1446→
  1447→    if (vote === undefined) {
  1448→      this.votes[validatorIndex] = {
  1449→        currentIndex: null,
  1450→        nextIndex,
  1451→        nextEpoch,
  1452→      };
  1453→    } else if (nextEpoch > vote.nextEpoch) {
  1454→      vote.nextIndex = nextIndex;
  1455→      vote.nextEpoch = nextEpoch;
  1456→    }
  1457→    // else its an old vote, don't count it
  1458→  }

  1460→  /**
  1461→   * Processes and removes from the queue any queued attestations which may now be eligible for
  1462→   * processing due to the slot clock incrementing.
  1463→   */
  1464→  private processAttestationQueue(): void {
  1465→    const currentSlot = this.fcStore.currentSlot;
  1466→    for (const [slot, byRoot] of this.queuedAttestations.entries()) {
  1467→      const targetEpoch = computeEpochAtSlot(slot);
  1468→      if (slot < currentSlot) {
  1469→        this.queuedAttestations.delete(slot);
  1470→        for (const [blockRoot, validatorIndices] of byRoot.entries()) {
  1471→          const blockRootHex = blockRoot;
  1472→          for (const validatorIndex of validatorIndices) {
  1473→            // equivocatingIndices was checked in onAttestation
  1474→            this.addLatestMessage(validatorIndex, targetEpoch, blockRootHex);
  1475→          }
  1476→
  1477→          if (slot === currentSlot - 1) {
  1478→            this.queuedAttestationsPreviousSlot += validatorIndices.size;
  1479→          }
  1480→        }
  1481→      } else {
  1482→        break;
  1483→      }
  1484→    }
  1485→  }

  1487→  /**
  1488→   * Called whenever the current time increases.
  1489→   *
  1490→   * ## Specification
  1491→   *
  1492→   * Equivalent to:
  1493→   *
  1494→   * https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.1.10/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#on_tick
  1495→   */
  1496→  private onTick(time: Slot): void {
  1497→    const previousSlot = this.fcStore.currentSlot;
  1498→
  1499→    if (time > previousSlot + 1) {
  1500→      throw new ForkChoiceError({
  1501→        code: ForkChoiceErrorCode.INCONSISTENT_ON_TICK,
  1502→        previousSlot,
  1503→        time,
  1504→      });
  1505→    }
  1506→
  1507→    // Update store time
  1508→    this.fcStore.currentSlot = time;
  1509→    // Reset proposer boost if this is a new slot.
  1510→    if (this.proposerBoostRoot) {
  1511→      // Since previous weight was boosted, we need would now need to recalculate the scores without the boost
  1512→      this.proposerBoostRoot = null;
  1513→    }
  1514→
  1515→    // Not a new epoch, return.
  1516→    if (computeSlotsSinceEpochStart(time) !== 0) {
  1517→      return;
  1518→    }
  1519→
  1520→    // If a new epoch, pull-up justification and finalization from previous epoch
  1521→    this.updateCheckpoints(
  1522→      this.fcStore.unrealizedJustified.checkpoint,
  1523→      this.fcStore.unrealizedFinalizedCheckpoint,
  1524→      () => this.fcStore.unrealizedJustified.balances
  1525→    );
  1526→  }

  1528→  /**
  1529→   *
  1530→   * Common logic of get_proposer_head() and should_override_forkchoice_update()
  1531→   * No one should be calling this function except these two
  1532→   *
  1533→   */
  1534→  private getPreliminaryProposerHead(
  1535→    headBlock: ProtoBlock,
  1536→    parentBlock: ProtoBlock,
  1537→    slot: Slot
  1538→  ): {prelimProposerHead: ProtoBlock; prelimNotReorgedReason?: NotReorgedReason} {
  1539→    let prelimProposerHead = headBlock;
  1540→    // No reorg if headBlock is on time
  1541→    // https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0-beta.4/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#is_head_late
  1542→    const isHeadLate = !headBlock.timeliness;
  1543→    if (!isHeadLate) {
  1544→      return {prelimProposerHead, prelimNotReorgedReason: NotReorgedReason.HeadBlockIsTimely};
  1545→    }
  1546→
  1547→    // No reorg if we are at epoch boundary where proposer shuffling could change
  1548→    // https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0-beta.4/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#is_shuffling_stable
  1549→    const isShufflingStable = slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH !== 0;
  1550→    if (!isShufflingStable) {
  1551→      return {prelimProposerHead, prelimNotReorgedReason: NotReorgedReason.NotShufflingStable};
  1552→    }
  1553→
  1554→    // No reorg if headBlock and parentBlock are not ffg competitive
  1555→    // https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0-beta.4/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#is_ffg_competitive
  1556→    const {unrealizedJustifiedEpoch: headBlockCpEpoch, unrealizedJustifiedRoot: headBlockCpRoot} = headBlock;
  1557→    const {unrealizedJustifiedEpoch: parentBlockCpEpoch, unrealizedJustifiedRoot: parentBlockCpRoot} = parentBlock;
  1558→    const isFFGCompetitive = headBlockCpEpoch === parentBlockCpEpoch && headBlockCpRoot === parentBlockCpRoot;
  1559→    if (!isFFGCompetitive) {
  1560→      return {prelimProposerHead, prelimNotReorgedReason: NotReorgedReason.NotFFGCompetitive};
  1561→    }
  1562→
  1563→    // No reorg if chain is not finalizing within REORG_MAX_EPOCHS_SINCE_FINALIZATION
  1564→    // https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0-beta.4/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#is_finalization_ok
  1565→    const epochsSinceFinalization = computeEpochAtSlot(slot) - this.getFinalizedCheckpoint().epoch;
  1566→    const isFinalizationOk = epochsSinceFinalization <= this.config.REORG_MAX_EPOCHS_SINCE_FINALIZATION;
  1567→    if (!isFinalizationOk) {
  1568→      return {prelimProposerHead, prelimNotReorgedReason: NotReorgedReason.ChainLongUnfinality};
  1569→    }
  1570→
  1571→    // No reorg if this reorg spans more than a single slot
  1572→    const parentSlotOk = parentBlock.slot + 1 === headBlock.slot;
  1573→    if (!parentSlotOk) {
  1574→      return {prelimProposerHead, prelimNotReorgedReason: NotReorgedReason.ParentBlockDistanceMoreThanOneSlot};
  1575→    }
  1576→
  1577→    prelimProposerHead = parentBlock;
  1578→
  1579→    return {prelimProposerHead};
  1580→  }
  1581→}

  1583→/**
  1584→ * This function checks the terminal pow conditions on the merge block as
  1585→ * specified in the config either via TTD or TBH. This function is part of
  1586→ * forkChoice because if the merge block was previously imported as syncing
  1587→ * and the EL eventually signals it catching up via validateLatestHash
  1588→ * the specs mandates validating terminal conditions on the previously
  1589→ * imported merge block.
  1590→ */
  1591→export function assertValidTerminalPowBlock(
  1592→  config: ChainConfig,
  1593→  block: bellatrix.BeaconBlock,
  1594→  preCachedData: {
  1595→    executionStatus: ExecutionStatus.Syncing | ExecutionStatus.Valid;
  1596→    powBlock?: PowBlockHex | null;
  1597→    powBlockParent?: PowBlockHex | null;
  1598→  }
  1599→): void {
  1600→  if (!ssz.Root.equals(config.TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH, ZERO_HASH)) {
  1601→    if (computeEpochAtSlot(block.slot) < config.TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH_ACTIVATION_EPOCH)
  1602→      throw Error(`Terminal block activation epoch ${config.TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH_ACTIVATION_EPOCH} not reached`);
  1603→
  1604→    // powBock.blockHash is hex, so we just pick the corresponding root
  1605→    if (!ssz.Root.equals(block.body.executionPayload.parentHash, config.TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH))
  1606→      throw new Error(
  1607→        `Invalid terminal block hash, expected: ${toRootHex(config.TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH)}, actual: ${toRootHex(
  1608→          block.body.executionPayload.parentHash
  1609→        )}`
  1610→      );
  1611→  } else {
  1612→    // If no TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH override, check ttd
  1613→
  1614→    // Delay powBlock checks if the payload execution status is unknown because of
  1615→    // syncing response in notifyNewPayload call while verifying
  1616→    if (preCachedData?.executionStatus === ExecutionStatus.Syncing) return;
  1617→
  1618→    const {powBlock, powBlockParent} = preCachedData;
  1619→    if (!powBlock) throw Error("onBlock preCachedData must include powBlock");
  1620→    // if powBlock is genesis don't assert powBlockParent
  1621→    if (!powBlockParent && powBlock.parentHash !== HEX_ZERO_HASH)
  1622→      throw Error("onBlock preCachedData must include powBlockParent");
  1623→
  1624→    const isTotalDifficultyReached = powBlock.totalDifficulty >= config.TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY;
  1625→    // If we don't have powBlockParent here, powBlock is the genesis and as we would have errored above
  1626→    // we can mark isParentTotalDifficultyValid as valid
  1627→    const isParentTotalDifficultyValid =
  1628→      !powBlockParent || powBlockParent.totalDifficulty < config.TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY;
  1629→    if (!isTotalDifficultyReached) {
  1630→      throw Error(
  1631→        `Invalid terminal POW block: total difficulty not reached expected >= ${config.TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY}, actual = ${powBlock.totalDifficulty}`
  1632→      );
  1633→    }
  1634→
  1635→    if (!isParentTotalDifficultyValid) {
  1636→      throw Error(
  1637→        `Invalid terminal POW block parent: expected < ${config.TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY}, actual = ${powBlockParent.totalDifficulty}`
  1638→      );
  1639→    }
  1640→  }
  1641→}
  1642→// Approximate https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#calculate_committee_fraction
  1643→// Calculates proposer boost score when committeePercent = config.PROPOSER_SCORE_BOOST
  1644→export function getCommitteeFraction(
  1645→  justifiedTotalActiveBalanceByIncrement: number,
  1646→  config: {slotsPerEpoch: number; committeePercent: number}
  1647→): number {
  1648→  const committeeWeight = Math.floor(justifiedTotalActiveBalanceByIncrement / config.slotsPerEpoch);
  1649→  return Math.floor((committeeWeight * config.committeePercent) / 100);
  1650→}

    31→    justifiedEpoch,
    32→    justifiedRoot,
    33→    finalizedEpoch,
    34→    finalizedRoot,
    35→  }: {
    36→    pruneThreshold: number;
    37→    justifiedEpoch: Epoch;
    38→    justifiedRoot: RootHex;
    39→    finalizedEpoch: Epoch;
    40→    finalizedRoot: RootHex;
    41→  }) {
    42→    this.pruneThreshold = pruneThreshold;
    43→    this.justifiedEpoch = justifiedEpoch;
    44→    this.justifiedRoot = justifiedRoot;
    45→    this.finalizedEpoch = finalizedEpoch;
    46→    this.finalizedRoot = finalizedRoot;
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  static initialize(block: Omit<ProtoBlock, "targetRoot">, currentSlot: Slot): ProtoArray {
    50→    const protoArray = new ProtoArray({
    51→      pruneThreshold: DEFAULT_PRUNE_THRESHOLD,
    52→      justifiedEpoch: block.justifiedEpoch,
    53→      justifiedRoot: block.justifiedRoot,
    54→      finalizedEpoch: block.finalizedEpoch,
    55→      finalizedRoot: block.finalizedRoot,
    56→    });
    57→    protoArray.onBlock(
    58→      {
    59→        ...block,
    60→        // We are using the blockROot as the targetRoot, since it always lies on an epoch boundary
    61→        targetRoot: block.blockRoot,
    62→      } as ProtoBlock,
    63→      currentSlot
    64→    );
    65→    return protoArray;
    66→  }
    67→
    68→  /**
    69→   * Iterate backwards through the array, touching all nodes and their parents and potentially
    70→   * the best-child of each parent.
    71→   *
    72→   * The structure of the `self.nodes` array ensures that the child of each node is always
    73→   * touched before its parent.
    74→   *
    75→   * For each node, the following is done:
    76→   *
    77→   * - Update the node's weight with the corresponding delta.
    78→   * - Back-propagate each node's delta to its parents delta.
    79→   * - Compare the current node with the parents best-child, updating it if the current node
    80→   * should become the best child.
    81→   * - If required, update the parents best-descendant with the current node or its best-descendant.
    82→   */
    83→  applyScoreChanges({
    84→    deltas,
    85→    proposerBoost,
    86→    justifiedEpoch,
    87→    justifiedRoot,
    88→    finalizedEpoch,
    89→    finalizedRoot,
    90→    currentSlot,
    91→  }: {
    92→    deltas: number[];
    93→    proposerBoost: ProposerBoost | null;
    94→    justifiedEpoch: Epoch;
    95→    justifiedRoot: RootHex;
    96→    finalizedEpoch: Epoch;
    97→    finalizedRoot: RootHex;
    98→    currentSlot: Slot;
    99→  }): void {
   100→    if (deltas.length !== this.indices.size) {
   101→      throw new ProtoArrayError({
   102→        code: ProtoArrayErrorCode.INVALID_DELTA_LEN,
   103→        deltas: deltas.length,
   104→        indices: this.indices.size,
   105→      });
   106→    }
   107→
   108→    if (
   109→      justifiedEpoch !== this.justifiedEpoch ||
   110→      finalizedEpoch !== this.finalizedEpoch ||
   111→      justifiedRoot !== this.justifiedRoot ||
   112→      finalizedRoot !== this.finalizedRoot
   113→    ) {
   114→      this.justifiedEpoch = justifiedEpoch;
   115→      this.finalizedEpoch = finalizedEpoch;
   116→      this.justifiedRoot = justifiedRoot;
   117→      this.finalizedRoot = finalizedRoot;
   118→    }
   119→
   120→    // Iterate backwards through all indices in this.nodes
   121→    for (let nodeIndex = this.nodes.length - 1; nodeIndex >= 0; nodeIndex--) {
   122→      const node = this.nodes[nodeIndex];
   123→      if (node === undefined) {
   124→        throw new ProtoArrayError({
   125→          code: ProtoArrayErrorCode.INVALID_NODE_INDEX,
   126→          index: nodeIndex,
   127→        });
   128→      }
   129→
   130→      // There is no need to adjust the balances or manage parent of the zero hash since it
   131→      // is an alias to the genesis block. The weight applied to the genesis block is
   132→      // irrelevant as we _always_ choose it and it's impossible for it to have a parent.
   133→      if (node.blockRoot === HEX_ZERO_HASH) {
   134→        continue;
   135→      }
   136→
   137→      const currentBoost = proposerBoost && proposerBoost.root === node.blockRoot ? proposerBoost.score : 0;
   138→      const previousBoost =
   139→        this.previousProposerBoost && this.previousProposerBoost.root === node.blockRoot
   140→          ? this.previousProposerBoost.score
   141→          : 0;
   142→
   143→      // If this node's execution status has been marked invalid, then the weight of the node
   144→      // needs to be taken out of consideration after which the node weight will become 0
   145→      // for subsequent iterations of applyScoreChanges
   146→      const nodeDelta =
   147→        node.executionStatus === ExecutionStatus.Invalid
   148→          ? -node.weight
   149→          : deltas[nodeIndex] + currentBoost - previousBoost;
   150→
   151→      // Apply the delta to the node
   152→      node.weight += nodeDelta;
   153→
   154→      // Update the parent delta (if any)
   155→      const parentIndex = node.parent;
   156→      if (parentIndex !== undefined) {
   157→        const parentDelta = deltas[parentIndex];
   158→        if (parentDelta === undefined) {
   159→          throw new ProtoArrayError({
   160→            code: ProtoArrayErrorCode.INVALID_PARENT_DELTA,
   161→            index: parentIndex,
   162→          });
   163→        }
   164→
   165→        // back-propagate the nodes delta to its parent
   166→        deltas[parentIndex] += nodeDelta;
   167→      }
   168→    }
   169→
   170→    // A second time, iterate backwards through all indices in `this.nodes`.
   171→    //
   172→    // We _must_ perform these functions separate from the weight-updating loop above to ensure
   173→    // that we have a fully coherent set of weights before updating parent
   174→    // best-child/descendant.
   175→    for (let nodeIndex = this.nodes.length - 1; nodeIndex >= 0; nodeIndex--) {
   176→      const node = this.nodes[nodeIndex];
   177→      if (node === undefined) {
   178→        throw new ProtoArrayError({
   179→          code: ProtoArrayErrorCode.INVALID_NODE_INDEX,
   180→          index: nodeIndex,
   181→        });
   182→      }
   183→
   184→      // If the node has a parent, try to update its best-child and best-descendant.
   185→      const parentIndex = node.parent;
   186→      if (parentIndex !== undefined) {
   187→        this.maybeUpdateBestChildAndDescendant(parentIndex, nodeIndex, currentSlot);
   188→      }
   189→    }
   190→    // Update the previous proposer boost
   191→    this.previousProposerBoost = proposerBoost;
   192→  }
